source.role: pinned vanilla quest-content comparator; not SPT evaluator authority

observedComparatorShapes.shape: Customs-bound Scav elimination with AKS-74U-series weapon restriction

decision.review: Vanilla contains strong individual components of Route Security: multiple Customs Scav-elimination tasks and separate Customs objectives that require survival/extraction. The reviewed comparator set does not combine bounded ordinary-Scav clearance and required Customs extraction into the same objective contract. Route Security therefore remains differentiated by its bounded six-target logistics-restoration framing plus extraction, while same-raid temporal coupling remains a separate fail-closed evaluator question.

regressionBoundary: If the pinned vanilla comparator changes, or a vanilla quest is identified that combines ordinary-Scav elimination on Customs with mandatory successful extraction as one completion contract, this proof must be re-reviewed before materialization.
